text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~! What do I do, I messed up 
big time~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Before going to sleep yesterday, a friend 
gave me some dango. She said she bought 
too many and couldn't finish them...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“B-But get this! Turns out the expiration 
date was 11:00 PM yesterday~!!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd eat it in the morning, so I 
fell asleep without checking the 
expiration date...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! Wasting food like that...! Today 
is officially a day of reflection!! I'm so 
sorry!
